payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D dynamic programming table dp[i][j] computes probabilities in a random walk on a grid, used to calculate expected inversions for all vertex pairs.
payload.rationale: The core DP on distances (i,j) with recurrence dp[i][j] = (dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1])/2 is a classic 2D state transition, not tree-based, combinatorial, or search.
